title: An action/flow params dialog has no max-height and no internal scroll, so on a tall form the Submit button sits below the viewport with no way to reach it
body:
Found in a browser dogfood pass on `objectstack-ai/hotclm` (hotclm#45), on `@objectstack/*` **17.4.0**. Filed at the destination per that repo's `AGENTS.md` — *report, never patch*. ⛔ Not triaged: no `domain:*`, no priority, no assignee.

Second of three independent defects that each block the same action; the sibling cards are #17264 (a field-backed lookup rendering as a bare text box) and the file-widget one filed alongside this.

## Symptom — measured geometry, not an impression

An intake action's params dialog on a 950px-high viewport:

| Reading | Value |
|:--|:--|
| Dialog content height | **1162px** |
| Dialog `top` | **−106px** (already pushed above the viewport) |
| Viewport height | **950px** |
| `overflow-y` on the dialog | **`visible`** |
| Nearest scrollable ancestor | **none** |
| Submit button box | **y = 991** — below the fold |

⇒ The primary button is off-screen and **nothing scrolls**. Not "awkward on small screens": there is no gesture that reaches Submit. The page behind the modal does not scroll, the modal does not scroll, and the modal is already clipped at the top.

## Why this is not a niche viewport problem

950px of usable height is an ordinary laptop browser with a normal amount of chrome. The dialog's height is set by **how many params the author declared** — so any action with enough fields becomes unusable, and the author gets no signal at authoring time that they have crossed a line. The failure appears only in a browser, at one particular window height, on someone else's machine.

## Reproduce

```bash
git clone https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotclm && cd hotclm && pnpm install && pnpm demo
# sign in at /_console/, open the contract register, press the intake/launch action
# set the browser window to ~950px of viewport height
# observe: Submit is below the fold; nothing scrolls
```

## Expected

A params dialog caps its height against the viewport and scrolls its own body, keeping the action row (Submit / Cancel) reachable — the ordinary modal contract. ⛔ Not claimed here: whether the fix belongs to the dialog component, a layout token, or the console's modal shell.

⚠️ Worth deciding alongside the fix: whether an author declaring more params than a dialog can hold should get a **warning at authoring time**. A form that only fails on a short window is exactly the class of defect that ships.

## Related

hotclm#45 (the dogfood pass) · #17264 (sibling: the lookup param renders as a bare text input) · the file-widget card filed alongside

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#17250
